slides.headline: VISA JUST LAID OFF 2,600 EMPLOYEES
slides.body: Visa had about 34,100 employees last year. Now 7% of them are out, mostly from tech and product teams. Bloomberg broke the story, CNBC confirmed the CEO's memo

slides.headline: THE CEO WROTE THAT AI RESHAPED WORK AT VISA
slides.body: Ryan McInerney wrote to employees that AI is "helping to accelerate this evolution and shape the way work gets done at Visa." He said the company must "continue evolving how we work." AI was a big factor, not the only one

slides.headline: THE MONEY GOES TO A TECH MOST BANKS WON'T TOUCH
slides.body: Visa listed its new priorities: rich customers, international payments, business payments, stablecoins, and expanding into new countries. McInerney called it "a new era in commerce with real momentum." Visa drops its earnings report after market close today

slides.headline: HERE'S WHAT VISA KNOWS THAT YOU DON'T
slides.body: A company with 34,100 people just cut 7% because AI changed how work gets done. If Visa's own tech team wasn't safe, nobody is. The businesses adding AI right now aren't firing, they're handling more work with the same team
